stories.title: Thanksgiving Blackout Day 3 — Silence Across College Softball

x_posts.label: Post 1
x_posts.text: Day 3 of 5 in the NCAA D1 softball Thanksgiving blackout. No calls. No texts. No DMs. Contact resumes Saturday. The December transfer portal opens Sunday. Happy Thanksgiving — coaches are spending it planning rosters they can't yet discuss. #NCAASoftball

research.facts:
Thanksgiving Blackout Day 3
**Key Facts:**
- NCAA Division I softball Thanksgiving recruiting blackout runs Nov 25-29 — **[HIGH]** confirmed from nextcommit.ai NCAA calendar and ncsasports.org recruiting rules
- Today Nov 27 is Day 3 of the 5-day blackout — **[HIGH]** (Day 1 = Nov 25, Day 2 = Nov 26, Day 3 = Nov 27, Day 4 = Nov 28, Day 5 = Nov 29)
- Contact resumes Nov 29 (Saturday) — **[HIGH]** per ncsasports.org/softball/recruiting-rules-calendar
- December transfer portal window opens Dec 1 — **[HIGH]** per collegesoftball.app and ncsasports.org
- Dead period Dec 8-12 — **[MEDIUM]** sources differ (ncsasports.org Dec 8-12; readthefield.com Dec 9-12); using Dec 8-12 as range
- No calls, texts, emails, social media DMs to any recruit — **[HIGH]** per NCAA recruiting rules
- Programs using blackout for administrative prep: NLI paperwork, scholarship offer review — **[MEDIUM]** standard practice, inferred
**Sources:**
- https://www.ncsasports.org/softball/recruiting-rules-calendar
- https://readthefield.com/recruiting-calendars/softball

research.facts:
5-for-5 Enters December
**Key Facts:**
- Tenth Circuit reversed and vacated Wisne v. NCAA federal injunction (Nov 7) — **[HIGH]** from multiple prior pipeline runs confirmed
- 200+ state court cases covering 850+ athletes ongoing — **[MEDIUM]** per prior research; SI/Bloomberg sources
- State courts granting injunctions independently of federal ruling — **[HIGH]** per prior research
- NCAA's 5-for-5 rule adopted June 23, 2026 — **[HIGH]** per multiple sources
- Congressional legislation discussed as viable path — **[MEDIUM]** per prior research
- Marshall University group filed state court case (Cabell Circuit Court) — **[HIGH]** per marshall.edu
- Programs carrying athletes under state court protection orders — **[MEDIUM]** per prior research
**Sources:**
- https://www.si.com/onsi/softball/news/how-the-court-s-ncaa-5-for-5-ruling-impacts-college-softball
